rules.rule: Weight a pitcher's recent form over old, small postseason samples.
rules.why: Faded Peralta for never passing 5.2 IP in a playoff start; he threw 6 scoreless. His 0.93 ERA over 7 starts and a velocity jump were the real signal.

rules.rule: Safer parlays use two strong, independent props, not a team side in a coin-flip game.
In low-total games, anchor on the Under or pitcher props, not sides.
rules.why: Under 7 won while every side-based bet lost.

rules.rule: Unearned runs and single defensive plays swing sides. Totals and props absorb that variance better.
rules.why: One error decided the run line.
